build_ghmc_loss: build a GHMC classification loss module with configurable bins and momentum for gradient harmonization
build_ghmr_loss: build a GHMR regression loss module with configurable mu parameter and bins for gradient harmonization
test_GHMC_forward: test the GHMC forward pass with prediction tensors, binary targets, and label weights
test_GHMR_forward: test the GHMR forward pass with prediction tensors, regression targets, and label weights
refactor_GHMC_GHMR: refactor the GHMC and GHMR loss classes to be consistent with other loss modules
